_readme: 典籍目录页插图(docs/book-page-proposal.md §3)。每本书若干候选 prompt,gen-book-art.mjs 逐条调 Codex 出图进 scripts/.cache/book-art/,人眼挑一张(pick = 候选下标)后落 public/book-art/<组>/<slug>.png(只留 alpha 通道、800²,当 CSS 遮罩用)。prompt 守 §3.1:单色白描 / 减笔水墨、透明底、无字无印无框无人脸、主体占三分之一偏一侧、上方留白。
_style: Chinese baimiao (白描) ink line drawing with restrained light ink wash, SINGLE black ink only, on a FULLY TRANSPARENT background (alpha channel, nothing behind the strokes), no paper texture, no text, no Chinese characters, no seal, no border, no frame, no signature. Composition: the subject occupies about one third of the canvas and sits in the lower part, leaving the upper half mostly empty. Square 1024x1024.

dao/daodejing.alt: 青牛向关:老者骑牛背影,远处山间一座关隘
dao/daodejing.motif: 青牛向关(老子西出函谷,小传已交代此传说)
prompts: An old man seen entirely from behind, riding a water buffalo slowly away from the viewer toward a small distant mountain-pass gate; the buffalo and rider are small, placed in the lower-left third; a few sparse rocks; the gate is tiny and faint in the far distance; vast empty space above.

A single water buffalo seen from behind, walking leftward along a faint path toward a distant mountain pass with a small gate tower; no rider; a few wisps of mist; subject small in the lower-left third; the rest of the canvas empty.

ru/lunyu.alt: 杏坛:一株老杏树下铺着一领席,旁有几卷简册
ru/lunyu.motif: 杏坛(孔子讲学处的传说;画树与席,不画人)
prompts: An old apricot tree with a gnarled trunk and a few blossoming branches, beneath it a low wooden platform with a woven mat and two or three bundles of bamboo-slip scrolls lying on it; no people; the tree stands in the lower-right third with branches reaching up into empty space.
Three bundles of ancient bamboo-slip scrolls (简册) tied with cord, one partly unrolled, lying beside a small writing brush; drawn small in the lower-left third of the canvas; everything else empty.

bing/sunzi.motif: 四面旗(「其疾如风,其徐如林,侵掠如火,不动如山」)
prompts: Four tall ancient Chinese military banners on bamboo poles, planted on a low ridge, all streaming in a strong wind toward the right; the banners are plain cloth with NO characters or symbols; small figures absent; the group of banners is placed in the lower-right third, sky above left entirely empty.

A rugged mountain pass with a narrow river winding through it and a single small watchtower on the ridge; drawn with sparse dry-brush strokes; the scene sits in the lower third, the upper two thirds empty.

dao/qingjingjing.motif: 清泉石上(澄其心而神自清)
prompts: A small clear spring flowing over a few smooth rocks, thin ripples, two reeds; drawn very sparsely in the lower-left third; everything else empty.
A still mountain pool with one fallen leaf on the water and faint ripples spreading, a single rock at the edge; lower-right third; the rest empty.

dao/ganyingpian.alt: 一株树与它的影子(如影随形)
prompts: A single bare old tree standing on flat ground with its long shadow stretched across the ground beside it; the tree small in the lower-right third; sky empty.
A lone pine on a low rise, its shadow cast long toward the left on bare ground; sparse strokes; lower third only.

dao/zhuangzi-neipian.alt: 鲲鹏:一只大鸟扶摇而上,下方是海
prompts: A huge bird with vast wings rising upward in a spiral over a faint sea horizon, seen from far away, the bird small against immense empty sky, a few wave lines at the very bottom.
The silhouette of an enormous fish just beneath the surface of a dark sea and, above it, a great bird lifting off; both small, placed in the lower-left third; the rest empty.

dao/yinfujing.motif: 日月星轨(「观天之道,执天之行」)
prompts: A crescent moon and a small sun drawn as simple circles, with a few long thin arcs of star trails sweeping across; sparse, geometric, lower-right third; the rest empty.
An ancient Chinese armillary-like ring instrument (浑仪) drawn with a few thin lines, standing small in the lower-left third; a faint arc of stars above; the rest empty.
A small three-legged bronze cauldron (鼎) with a faint wisp of smoke rising, and a thin crescent moon above it; the cauldron small in the lower-left third; the rest empty.
A round alchemical furnace with a domed lid, a few flames at its base, and eight tiny moon phases arranged in a faint arc above; sparse; lower third.

dao/zhuangzi-waipian.alt: 濠梁之上观鱼:桥下几尾游鱼
prompts: A small arched stone footbridge over a stream, and beneath it three fish swimming, drawn with a few lines; no people; the bridge small in the lower-right third; the rest empty.
Several small fish gliding in clear water among water-weeds, seen from above, drawn with minimal strokes; lower-left third; everything else empty.

dao/zhuangzi-zapian.alt: 渔父之舟:一叶小舟泊在芦苇边
prompts: A single small fishing skiff moored among a few reeds at a river bank, a fishing rod resting across it, no people; the boat small in the lower-left third; the rest empty.
A lone narrow boat drifting on wide still water with a few reed stalks at the edge; sparse dry-brush; lower third.

A few long flowing ribbon-like cloth sleeves and wisps of wind-driven cloud sweeping diagonally, suggesting someone riding the wind, no body or face visible; drawn in the lower-right third; the rest empty.
Several thin curling lines of wind and a few small cloud puffs drifting across a low ridge; very sparse; lower third.
A few broken fragments of ancient bamboo slips, some cords frayed, lying scattered on bare ground; drawn small in the lower-left third; the rest empty.
Three damaged bamboo slips with worn edges, one cracked in half, placed loosely together in the lower-right third; the rest empty.

dao/huangting.alt: 庭中一株桂树与一轮月
prompts: A small courtyard corner with a single osmanthus tree and a full moon above it, a low wall suggested with two lines; the tree in the lower-right third; the rest empty.
A round moon gate in a garden wall with one tree branch reaching through it; sparse; lower-left third.
A single lotus flower on a tall stem rising from still water with one leaf, drawn with a few lines; lower-left third; the rest empty.
A lotus bud and one unfurled leaf above calm water, two small ripples; sparse; lower-right third.
An empty round straw meditation cushion on a flat rock beneath a leaning pine, no person; drawn small in the lower-right third; the rest empty.
A single pine tree bending over a bare rock ledge, a few needles falling; very sparse; lower-left third.
A tiny thatched hut half hidden among mountain folds with mist drifting across, drawn with sparse strokes; the hut small in the lower-right third; the rest empty.
A thatched hermit hut beside a single tall pine on a slope, clouds below the slope; sparse; lower-left third.
An ancient round bronze mirror on a simple wooden stand, its face blank and bright, drawn with a few lines; small in the lower-left third; the rest empty.
A round bronze mirror lying flat, reflecting a thin crescent moon; sparse; lower-right third.

ru/mengzi.alt: 牛山:一座光秃的山上几株新芽
prompts: A rounded bare hill with only a few small tree sprouts on its slope and two tiny grazing oxen far away, drawn sparsely; the hill in the lower third; the rest empty.
A bald mountain outline with one surviving tree on the ridge and a few sprouting shoots at its foot; sparse; lower-right third.
A flight of eight plain stone steps rising diagonally into empty space, a small pine at the bottom; drawn in the lower-left third; the rest empty.
Eight stone steps leading up to a simple gate drawn with a few lines; sparse; lower-right third.

A kite (bird of prey) soaring high with wings spread, and far below a fish leaping from the water with a few splash lines; both small, the fish in the lower-left, the bird in the upper-right quadrant with lots of empty space between.
A single hawk gliding above a calm river where one fish breaks the surface; very sparse; the scene in the lower half.
A crow perched on a bare branch feeding another older crow beside it, drawn with a few strokes; the branch enters from the lower-right corner; the rest empty.
Two crows on a leafless bough, one leaning toward the other; sparse; lower-left third.
A clump of indigo plants beside a wide earthen dye vat, a dipped length of cloth hanging from a pole above the vat; drawn small in the lower-left third; the rest empty.
A large earthen dye vat with a long strip of cloth draped out of it and a few indigo leaves on the ground; sparse; lower-right third.
A low wooden writing desk with an oil lamp, an open book and a brush, no person; drawn small in the lower-right third; the rest empty.
A single oil lamp burning on a desk corner next to a stack of three books; sparse; lower-left third.

A full moon emerging above a low bank of thinning rain clouds, a few bamboo leaves dripping in the lower corner; drawn sparsely; the moon in the upper-right, the bamboo in the lower-left, mostly empty.
A bright moon over a quiet pond after rain, one lotus leaf holding a drop of water; sparse; lower third.
A pair of small water birds (ospreys) standing on a sandy islet in a river, a few reeds and ripple lines; drawn small in the lower-left third; the rest empty.
Two water birds on a river bank among reeds, one calling; sparse; lower-right third.
